bio.text: David Brock Smith is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Oregon in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.
He has served in the Oregon State Senate, representing District 1, since January 2023, and before that represented District 1 in the Oregon House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023.

Ballotpedia reports he was born in Port Orford, Oregon, earned an associate degree from Southwestern Oregon Community College, lists Southern Oregon University among his education, and worked in the culinary industry.
It also reports he served as Port Orford City Council president and as president of the chamber of commerce.
